confidence.rule: absolute LLR bins with hard confidence .5/.75/.9/.99; lower-inclusive
confidence.scope: offline calibration diagnostic; not selection thresholds

calibration.llr_scope: actual final clipped detector LLR; offline truth scoring only

costs.scope: instrumented full receiver and adapter; excludes generator and offline diagnostics/IO

initial_estimator.pruning: final gamma threshold; posterior mean; no LS debias

metadata.code_randomness: fixed generator; reserved stream is not consumed
metadata.interleaver: identity; reserved stream is not consumed

pilot_common.scope: generator-only shared external block; no H returned to receiver

metadata.pilot_reconstruction: Hp+(Hx+noise); p0 agrees numerically, not asserted bit-exact to original H(p+x)+noise

power.deployment_scope: declared simulation gate only; no hardware amplifier validation
power.normalization: none; preserve original rho and individual pilot+data cross energy

refit.terminal_sigma_policy: unchanged B_star terminal sigma; no oracle recalibration

source_input.scope: offline evidence with truth; observed receiver does not receive this path

terminal.transfer_policy: raw stays at output path; no automatic transfer
